datasets.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) / Airbus Defence and Space; AWS Open Data mirror
datasets.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 Digital Surface Model (DSM), 3 arc-second COG
datasets.license: Copernicus DEM GLO-90: free basis for the general public (AWS Open Data registry), under the Copernicus Contributing Mission Data Access Licence terms
datasets.notes: GLO-90 DSM (COP-DEM_GLO-90-DGED source) from the 2021 Copernicus DEM release, mirrored as public COGs in s3://copernicus-dem-90m (eu-central-1). 3 arc-second native grid, EPSG:4326, EGM2008 heights in metres. DSM includes buildings, infrastructure and vegetation; ocean areas have no tiles. Each COG uses 2048x2048 internal blocks, so a window range-read may transfer the containing block. Attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-90 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved. Batch checksum covers canonical candidate records, not full source objects. Updated checksum covers canonical derived records, including individual window checksums.
